title: ChatGPT Work: An Agent That Delivers Finished Work
hook: ChatGPT Work doesn't just chat — it reaches into your actual apps and files, grinds on a project for hours, and hands back a real spreadsheet or slide deck instead of a wall of text.
key_points: ChatGPT Work is an agent that acts across connected apps and files, staying on a task for hours by working through it independently.
It delivers finished artifacts — a working spreadsheet, slide deck, document, or small hosted web app — not markdown to copy-paste.
Plugins connect it to where work happens: Slack, Teams, Google Drive, SharePoint, email, calendars, CRMs, and project trackers.
'Computer Use' lets it operate a user's computer directly — clicking, typing, moving files — plus a built-in browser for web tools.
Rolling out first to Pro, Enterprise, and Edu accounts, expanding to Plus and Business users within days.
content_html: ChatGPT Work is OpenAI's pitch for turning ChatGPT from an assistant you copy-paste from into an agent that finishes the job itself. Connected to a user's apps and files, it can stay on a complex project for hours, breaking it into steps and working through most of them unsupervised.
extra_html:
Three things separate it from a chatbot: it produces real artifacts (a working spreadsheet, a polished slide deck, a structured document, or even a small hosted web app) rather than text to hand-copy elsewhere; plugins wire it into the tools work already lives in — Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Drive, SharePoint, email, calendars, CRMs, and project trackers; and a new built-in browser plus a "Computer Use" feature let it act on local files and click/type its way through tasks in the background.

It's OpenAI pushing further into the "agent that does the work, not just describes it" pitch every frontier lab is chasing right now. Rollout starts with Pro, Enterprise, and Edu accounts before reaching Plus and Business users over the following days. OpenAI, July 2026.

flashcards.prompt: What makes ChatGPT Work's output different from a typical chatbot reply?
flashcards.back_html: It delivers a finished artifact — a real spreadsheet with formulas, a formatted deck, a structured document, or a small hosted web app — instead of markdown text you'd have to copy and paste yourself.

flashcards.prompt: How does ChatGPT Work connect to tools like Slack or Google Drive?

choices.text: Through plugins that link ChatGPT to those apps and systems
Users must manually email files to OpenAI for processing
It cannot connect to any third-party app

flashcards.explanation_html: Plugins are the integration layer, wiring ChatGPT into chat tools, file storage, email, calendars, CRMs, and project trackers so the agent can gather context and act.

flashcards.prompt: What is 'Computer Use' in ChatGPT Work?
flashcards.back_html: A feature that lets ChatGPT operate a user's computer directly — clicking, typing, and moving files — to execute tasks across apps and the browser on the user's behalf.
